# Feature Review Checklist: To-Do List Web App

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the requirements in the spec, focused on error states, the clarified rename and ordering rules, name validation, accessibility, and scenario coverage, before task generation
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope defaults used** (no interactive answers were given): depth standard, audience reviewer, focus on the four clusters below.
- Error and empty states (FR-011, FR-012, Edge Cases)
- Clarified rename and ordering rules (Story 6, FR-002, FR-013 to FR-015, Clarifications)
- Name rules across add and rename (FR-003, FR-004, FR-010, FR-014)
- Accessibility and measurable outcomes (SC-001 to SC-007, constitution III)

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are retry requirements for a failed item-list load stated in the spec, or only in the plan? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK002 Are error-message requirements defined for each failed action (add, toggle, rename, delete), or only for a failed load? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for a rename that fails because the service is unreachable, including what the name shows afterwards? [Gap, Spec §Story 6]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the welcome message when the service that provides it is unavailable? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for an open rename dialog whose item was deleted by another user before the user saves? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for whether the add form keeps or clears the typed name after a failed add? [Gap, Spec §Story 1]
- [x] CHK007 Does the spec state that renaming an item keeps its position in the list, or is that only implied by FR-002? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "visible error message" quantified with where it appears, how long it stays, and whether the user must dismiss it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, FR-012]
- [x] CHK009 Is the "no longer exists" feedback wording specified, or left to the implementer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Is "oldest first" tied to a defined time source (when the item was added), and is that source specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Clarifications Q3]
- [x] CHK011 Is "whitespace-only" defined, including whether tabs and other blank characters count, or only spaces? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK012 Is the 255-character limit defined as characters or bytes, and is multi-byte text covered? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK013 Is "at the top of the page" (FR-001) defined in terms that can be checked? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK014 Does the spec state whether leading and trailing spaces are removed from a name, or only that space-only names are rejected? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, FR-014]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Do the empty-state rule (FR-003) and the error-state rule (FR-012) define separate conditions, so a failed load never matches both? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, FR-012]
- [x] CHK016 Are name rules identical for add (FR-004) and rename (FR-014), including the 1-to-255 length? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, FR-010, FR-014]
- [x] CHK017 Do the Assumptions ("used by one person at a time") agree with the clarified shared list (Clarifications Q2) for simultaneous use? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK018 Does the disabled-submit rule (FR-005) agree with the whitespace rule (FR-004) for the add control? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, FR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Is "keyboard only" (SC-005) defined for every control, including the rename dialog's input, Save, and Cancel? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK020 Is the restart scenario in SC-002 bounded (clean shutdown, crash, or both)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK021 Is SC-001 ("within 30 seconds without instructions") defined with a user profile or sample size? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK022 Is the start point of the 2-second target in SC-006 defined (request sent, first paint, or full list rendered)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK023 Can SC-007 ("under 20 seconds") be checked against a defined set of steps? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for two users adding or editing items at the same time on the shared list, or is that intentionally excluded? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK025 Are recovery requirements defined for a save that fails partway (for example a rename that does not complete)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for first use when no stored data exists yet? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for a page reload while an add or rename is still in progress? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Story 1, Story 6]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Are boundary values (1, 255, and 256 characters) specified for name length? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010, FR-014]
- [x] CHK029 Are requirements defined for names containing line breaks or characters outside plain text? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for how a long name is displayed (wrapped, truncated, or scrolled) in the list? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-002]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK031 Are focus-management requirements for the rename dialog (initial focus, trap, return of focus on close) in the spec, or only in the plan? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §Story 6]
- [x] CHK032 Are screen-reader announcement requirements for add, toggle, rename, delete, and load errors defined in the spec, or only in the constitution? [Gap, Constitution III]
- [x] CHK033 Is the 2-second target (SC-006) defined for conditions other than the local case, or only for local use? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK034 Are write-access requirements defined for a shared list, so that any user can change any item? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications Q2, Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK035 Is the "no user accounts" assumption checked against any requirement to record who changed an item? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK036 Is the 255-character limit traced to a requirement, or only to the storage design? [Dependency, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK037 Are the plan's required changes (ordering position, 404 on missing delete) traced to spec requirements FR-002 and FR-011? [Traceability, Plan §Summary]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK038 Does the Assumption "used by one person at a time" conflict with the shared-list decision in Clarifications Q2? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK039 Is there a requirement ID scheme that links acceptance scenarios to functional requirements, or are links made by reading? [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Traceability: 39 of 39 items reference a spec section, plan section, or marker (≥80% required)
